info.name: DesignCraft integration
info.summary: Edit page layouts in Nextcloud with DesignCraft
info.description:
Open a DesignCraft document or an IDML package in Files with **Edit in DesignCraft** and work on it right in the browser: pages and spreads, master pages, text frames and threaded stories, paragraph and character styles, pictures, colours and swatches, tables and exports.
- **Save** writes a DesignCraft document straight back to Nextcloud, and Nextcloud keeps the previous state as a file version. An IDML package is saved as a new DesignCraft document next to it (you pick the name and folder); **File › Export › IDML** writes the .idml back. - **Export** (PDF, PNG, EPUB, text) stores a file in any folder you pick. - Read-only files open normally; saving offers a copy. - If someone else changes the file while you have it open, you choose whether to replace their version or save a copy. - Optionally, clicking a document in Files opens it in DesignCraft.
DesignCraft runs entirely in your browser as WebAssembly. Files go only between your browser and your Nextcloud, and the server needs no extra software.
This is a community integration based on [DesignCraft](https://github.com/storytold/designcraft) by the ArtCraft team, an open-source, Rust-native page layout app. It embeds a build of DesignCraft and is not made or endorsed by the ArtCraft team.
**Requirements:** a browser with WebGPU or WebGL2, and a web server that serves `.wasm` files as `application/wasm` (Nextcloud's own Apache and nginx configurations do).
info.author: Britton Couchman
